audit.framework_rationale: TensorCircuit performs state preparation, all circuit gates, Hamiltonian application, reduced-density-matrix construction, and Renyi entropy computation. NumPy, JAX, and Optax provide legitimate initialization, differentiation, compilation, optimization, and output conversion; no other quantum framework is imported.
audit.cheating_rationale: The source computes actual circuit objectives and gradients without fabricated histories, hidden answers, evaluator inspection, or test modifications. The fixed random seed provides reproducible Gaussian initialization.
audit.fidelity_rationale: The implementation follows the specified initial state, 243-parameter even/odd ansatz, open-boundary XXZ Hamiltonian, three block checkpoints, configured entropy targets and loss, and exactly max_steps Adam updates. Histories contain pre-update measurements and return the required NumPy arrays. Doubling interaction angles correctly accounts for TensorCircuit's half-angle convention, and commuting XX, YY, and ZZ rotations implement the requested interaction exponential. See [TensorCircuit gate definitions](https://tensorcircuit.readthedocs.io/en/latest/_modules/tensorcircuit/gates.html). The entropy routine computes the required natural-log Renyi-2 expression. See [TensorCircuit entropy implementation](https://tensorcircuit-ng.readthedocs.io/en/latest/_modules/tensorcircuit/quantities.html). Residual entropy mismatch is an optimization outcome, not a missing penalty.
audit.implementation_error_rationale: No obvious logic, indexing, gate-scaling, objective, update-order, or output-format error is apparent for the specified configuration.
